newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL REVEAL INTEREST IN INCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL REVEAL INTEREST IN INCE.

text.p: Arsenal would be tempted to bid for England midfielder Paul Ince if Inter Milan put him on the market, the English side's manager Arsene Wenger said on Tuesday.
"We would think it over if Paul Ince became available," Wenger said. "Yes, of course."
"Inter will decide the future of Ince because he is under contract but, for his quality, yes we would be interested, just like many other clubs."
Ince, who joined Inter from English champions Manchester United, was linked with a move to Arsenal last season but his financial demands proved a stumbling block.
He has been the subject of racial abuse from opposing fans in Italy and has a poor disciplinary record in serie A.
But while Arsenal are interested in Ince, Wenger said they were not considering a bid for Juergen Klinsmann, the former Tottenham striker who is now reportedly unsettled at Bayern Munich.
Wenger signed Klinsmann for Monaco four years ago but said the 32-year-old was not now a target.

"Ideally I always want to buy cheap, good and young," he said. "I cannot believe Klinsmann will leave Bayern now for less than a two-or three-year contract and we would not be interested in that at his age."
